# High-level design: Subscription domain Owner: Modelling agent · generated by `src/generators/emit-docs.js` from blueprint `fc71a1458dce` · regenerated whenever the org changes Structure follows arc42; context and container views follow C4; decisions are recorded as ADRs. ## 1. Introduction and goals | | | |---|---| | Source | Salesforce org, 505 objects described | | Domain in scope | Subscription, Subscription Line | | Reference objects | Account, Contact, Opportunity, Product | | Target | PostgreSQL on Azure, services and admin app, released by CI/CD | | Data | Account 22 · Contact 20 · Opportunity 31 · Product 17 · Subscription 107 · Subscription Line 219 | Quality goals, in priority order: **behavioural parity** with Salesforce, **security** equal to the org’s, **traceability** from every artifact to its source, **repeatability** of every phase. ## 2. Constraints - Salesforce stays the system of record until each domain is cut over. - Only Salesforce-supported APIs and the Salesforce CLI are used to read the org; nothing is written back. - Generated code is reviewed at a gate before it merges; the model never sits in the runtime path. - Items Salesforce does not hand over are handled through the gap register (`adlc/1-discover/extraction/inventory/gap-register.md`). ## 3. Context and scope (C4 level 1) ```mermaid flowchart LR AM(["Account managers
[person]"]) SA(["Service and operations users
[person]"]) AD(["Administrators and reviewers
[person]"]) SF[("Salesforce org
[existing system] source of metadata and data")] MIG["Org Compiler
[system] agents that extract, design, build, migrate and validate"] TGT["Client-owned CRM
[system] PostgreSQL + services + app on Azure"] EXT(["Integrated systems
[external] callers found in login history"]) SF -- "metadata and data (CLI, REST, Bulk)" --> MIG MIG -- "generated schema, rules, data" --> TGT AD -- "reviews each gate" --> MIG AM -- "sell, renew" --> TGT SA -- "serve" --> TGT EXT -. "Salesforce-compatible API (planned)" .-> TGT classDef sys fill:#E6ECFC,stroke:#2450D6,color:#18212F; class MIG,TGT sys; ``` ## 4. Solution strategy | Concern | Approach | Decision | |---|---|---| | One source of truth | Vendor-neutral blueprint between extraction and generation | [ADR-001](adr/ADR-001-blueprint-contract.md) | | Identity of records | Salesforce IDs kept as keys | [ADR-002](adr/ADR-002-keep-salesforce-ids.md) | | Calculated fields | Generated columns, views, computed on read, trigger-maintained roll-ups | ADR-003 to ADR-006 | | Business rules | CHECK constraints and BEFORE-trigger guards | ADR-007, ADR-008 | | Access | Roles, column grants and row-level security | [ADR-009](adr/ADR-009-roles-and-rls.md) | | Custom code | AI-translated, reviewed before merge | [ADR-010](adr/ADR-010-reviewed-llm-translation.md) | | Acceptance | Parity with Salesforce’s own values | [ADR-011](adr/ADR-011-parity-as-acceptance.md) | ## 5. Runtime view: business processes ### 6.1 Subscription lifecycle Statuses come from the Status picklist; the notes come from the validation rules that guard each status. ```mermaid stateDiagram-v2 [*] --> Draft Draft --> Active Active --> Suspended Suspended --> Active Active --> Renewed Renewed --> [*] Draft --> Cancelled Active --> Cancelled Suspended --> Cancelled Cancelled --> [*] note right of Active needs MRR above zero end note note right of Cancelled needs a cancellation reason
cannot be reactivated end note ``` ### 6.2 Won deal becomes a subscription When an opportunity is marked Closed Won, a subscription is created for the account, once per deal. ```mermaid sequenceDiagram autonumber actor Rep as Sales rep participant O as Opportunity participant S as OpportunityService participant Sub as Subscription Rep->>O: set stage to Closed Won O->>S: after update: createSubscriptionsForWonDeals() S->>Sub: any subscription already created for this deal? alt none yet S->>Sub: insert subscription (term 12 months) else already exists S-->>O: skip (no duplicates) end Sub-->>Rep: subscription visible on the account ``` ### 6.3 Saving a subscription What happens, in Salesforce’s order, every time a subscription is saved. ```mermaid sequenceDiagram autonumber actor U as User or integration participant SF as Subscription participant SubscriptionService as SubscriptionService U->>SF: create or update a subscription SF->>SubscriptionService: before save: applyDefaults() SF->>SF: validation rules (4) Note right of SF: Active Requires MRR
Cancellation Reason Required

No Reactivation After Cancel SF->>SubscriptionService: after save: handleStatusChange() SubscriptionService-->>SF: insert Task participant Flow as Flow SF->>Flow: Subscription At Risk Alert Note right of Flow: when AND( Health_Score__c #lt; 50, Status__c = Active ) Flow-->>SF: create Task SF-->>U: saved, or the first failing rule’s message ``` ### 6.4 Subscription At Risk Alert Raises a check-in task when an active subscription drops below the at-risk health threshold. ```mermaid flowchart TD START(["Subscription created or updated
after save"]) FILTER{{"AND( Health Score #lt; 50, Status = Active )"}} START --> FILTER FILTER -- "no" --> SKIP(["no action"]) Create_Health_Check_Task["create Task
Create Health Check Task"] FILTER -- "yes" --> Create_Health_Check_Task classDef el fill:#F3F1FC,stroke:#6666CC,color:#1F1F2E; ``` ### 6.5 Renewal reminders A scheduled job raises a renewal task before each active subscription ends. ```mermaid flowchart TD A(["Nightly schedule"]) --> B["Find active subscriptions
ending within 30 days"] B --> C{"Any found?"} C -- "yes" --> D["Create a renewal task
for each owner"] C -- "no" --> E(["Done"]) D --> E classDef job fill:#EAFBF5,stroke:#2CDCAA,color:#1F1F2E; class A,B,D job; ``` ### 6.6 Case routing and escalation Assignment rules route each new case; escalation rules raise cases that miss their target time (outside the subscription domain; listed for completeness). ```mermaid flowchart TD S(["New case"]) C0{{"BillingCountry = US

SLA = Gold, Platinum
Type contains Customer"}} C1 -- "no" --> C2 C2 -- "yes" --> R2["assign to assigned user"] C3{{"BillingCountry ≠ US
SLA = Silver, Bronze
Type contains Customer"}} C2 -- "no" --> C3 C3 -- "yes" --> R3["assign to assigned user"] C4{{"Type contains Partner"}} C3 -- "no" --> C4 C4 -- "yes" --> R4["assign to assigned user"] C4 -- "no" --> N(["no change"]) ``` | Escalation rule | Applies when | |---|---| | 1 | BillingCountry = US; SLA = Platinum; Priority = High | | 2 | BillingCountry = US; SLA = Platinum; Priority = Medium,Low | | 3 | BillingCountry = US; SLA = Gold; Priority = High | | 4 | BillingCountry = US; SLA = Gold; Priority = Medium,Low | | 5 | BillingCountry = US; SLA = Silver | | 6 | BillingCountry = US; SLA = Bronze | | 7 | BillingCountry ≠ US; SLA = Gold,Platinum | | 8 | BillingCountry ≠ US; SLA = Silver,Bronze | ## 7. Deployment view Resources parsed from `adlc/6-go-live/infra/main.bicep`. ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph AZ["Azure resource group (adlc/6-go-live/infra/main.bicep)"] pg["pg
flexibleServers"] db["db
flexibleServers/databases"] fwAzure["fwAzure
flexibleServers/firewallRules"] fwDeployer["fwDeployer
flexibleServers/firewallRules"] plan["plan

sites"] scmPolicy["scmPolicy
sites/basicPublishingCredentialsPolicies"] end GH["GitHub Actions"] -- "zip deploy" --> site site -- "TLS, pg" --> pg DEV["Engineer workstation
sf CLI, extraction"] -- "load_db.ps1" --> pg ``` ## 8. Cross-cutting concepts ### 8.1 Data model ```mermaid erDiagram Account { varchar id PK varchar name text type varchar billing_country text customer_priority text sla text active numeric numberof_locations text upsell_opportunity varchar sla_serial_number } Contact { varchar id PK varchar name text level varchar languages } Opportunity { varchar id PK varchar name text stage_name numeric amount text delivery_installation_status varchar tracking_number varchar order_number varchar current_generators varchar main_competitors text loss_reason } Product { varchar id PK varchar name } Subscription { varchar id PK varchar subscription_number varchar account_id FK boolean auto_renew varchar cancellation_reason date end_date numeric health_score numeric monthly_recurring_revenue date start_date text status } SubscriptionLine { varchar id PK varchar line_number varchar subscription_id FK numeric quantity numeric unit_price varchar account_name numeric line_total } Account |o--o{ Contact : "Account ID" Account |o--o{ Opportunity : "Account ID" Contact |o--o{ Opportunity : "Contact ID" Subscription ||--|{ SubscriptionLine : "Subscription" Product |o--o{ SubscriptionLine : "Product" Account ||--|{ Subscription : "Account" Contact |o--o{ Subscription : "Primary Contact" Opportunity |o--o{ Subscription : "Source Opportunity" ``` ### 8.2 Security model Each profile or permission set becomes a database role; field-level security becomes column grants; subscriptions inherit access from their account. ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph SFS["Salesforce"] profile_Admin["Profile: Admin"] profile_Analytics_Cloud_Integration_User["Profile: Analytics Cloud Integration User"] permissionSet_Subscription_Management["Permission set: Subscription_Management"] OWD["Account sharing
(org-wide default)"] end subgraph PG["PostgreSQL"] PG_profile_Admin["role admin"] PG_profile_Analytics_Cloud_Integration_User["role analytics cloud integration user"] PG_permissionSet_Subscription_Management["role subscription_management"] RLS["row-level security
can_access_account()"] COL["column grants
(field-level security)"] end profile_Admin --> PG_profile_Admin PG_profile_Admin --> COL profile_Analytics_Cloud_Integration_User --> PG_profile_Analytics_Cloud_Integration_User PG_profile_Analytics_Cloud_Integration_User --> COL permissionSet_Subscription_Management --> PG_permissionSet_Subscription_Management PG_permissionSet_Subscription_Management --> COL OWD --> RLS SUB["Subscription and lines
inherit access from the account"] --> RLS ``` ### 8.3 Data migration Records load parent first, in dependency order, keeping every Salesforce record ID. ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph L0["Level 1"] Account["Account
22 rows"] Product2["Product
17 rows"] end subgraph L1["Level 2"] Contact["Contact
20 rows"] end subgraph L2["Level 3"] Opportunity["Opportunity
31 rows"] end subgraph L3["Level 4"] Subscription__c["Subscription
107 rows"] end subgraph L4["Level 5"] Subscription_Line__c["Subscription Line
219 rows"] end L0 --> L1 L1 --> L2 L2 --> L3 L3 --> L4 ``` ### 8.4 Traceability Every generated file names its owning agent and blueprint; the LLD’s traceability matrix links each Salesforce element to its design decision, artifact and test. ## 9. Architecture decisions | ADR | Decision | Applies to | |---|---|---| | [ADR-001](adr/ADR-001-blueprint-contract.md) | A vendor-neutral blueprint is the contract between extraction and generation | 1 | | [ADR-002](adr/ADR-002-keep-salesforce-ids.md) | Keep the 18-character Salesforce ID as the primary key | 6 | | [ADR-003](adr/ADR-003-generated-columns.md) | Row-local formulas become stored generated columns | 2 | | [ADR-004](adr/ADR-004-cross-object-views.md) | Cross-object formulas become views | 1 | | [ADR-005](adr/ADR-005-compute-on-read.md) | Date-dependent formulas are computed when read | 1 | | [ADR-006](adr/ADR-006-trigger-maintained-rollups.md) | Roll-up summaries are trigger-maintained columns with a recompute job | 2 | | [ADR-007](adr/ADR-007-check-constraints.md) | Row-local validation rules become CHECK constraints | 6 | | [ADR-008](adr/ADR-008-guard-triggers.md) | Rules needing the previous row or a parent record become BEFORE-trigger guards | 2 | | [ADR-009](adr/ADR-009-roles-and-rls.md) | Profiles and permission sets become roles; sharing becomes row-level security | 3 | | [ADR-010](adr/ADR-010-reviewed-llm-translation.md) | Apex is translated by an AI agent and merged only after review | 2 | | [ADR-011](adr/ADR-011-parity-as-acceptance.md) | Behaviour is accepted only when it matches Salesforce’s own values | 1 | ## 10. Quality requirements | Quality | Scenario | How it is measured | |---|---|---| | Parity | Every calculated value and rule outcome matches Salesforce | Verification agent, blocking in CI | | Security | A user sees and edits only what Salesforce allows | Security parity cases, RLS and column grants | | Repeatability | Same org in, same outputs out | CI regenerates blueprint, SQL and documents and fails on any difference | | Traceability | Any artifact leads back to its Salesforce source | Provenance headers and the LLD traceability matrix, checked in CI | ## 11. Risks and technical debt | Item | Status | |---|---| | Apex translated | SubscriptionService.applyDefaults | | Automations still to translate | OpportunityTrigger, SubscriptionTrigger, SubscriptionRenewalBatch | | Items Salesforce keeps | gap register (adlc/1-discover/extraction/inventory/gap-register.md) | ## 12. Glossary | Business term | Salesforce object | Target table | |---|---|---| | Account | Account | account | | Contact | Contact | contact | | Opportunity | Opportunity | opportunity | | Product | Product2 | product2 | | Subscription | Subscription__c | subscription | | Subscription Line | Subscription_Line__c | subscription_line |

adrs.ADR-001:
# ADR-001: A vendor-neutral blueprint is the contract between extraction and generation

Status: Accepted · Owner: Modelling agent · Blueprint `fc71a1458dce`

## Context

Extractors speak Salesforce; generators speak PostgreSQL. Coupling them directly makes every new source or target a rewrite.

## Decision

All generators read only the blueprint (JSON, validated against blueprint.schema.json, content-hashed). Extraction never talks to generation.

## Consequences

Re-runs are deterministic and diffable; a new target needs one emitter. The schema must evolve with care (versioned).

## Applies to (1)

- `adlc/2-design/modelling/blueprint/blueprint.json`
adrs.ADR-002:
# ADR-002: Keep the 18-character Salesforce ID as the primary key

Status: Accepted · Owner: Modelling agent · Blueprint `fc71a1458dce`

## Context

Integrations, reports and users hold Salesforce IDs; a migration that renumbers records breaks them.

## Decision

Every table keeps the Salesforce ID as its key; new records get IDs in the same format from the runtime.

## Consequences

Links, bookmarks and the compatibility API keep working; keys are text, not integers.

## Applies to (6)

- `Account.Id`
- `Contact.Id`
- `Opportunity.Id`
- `Product2.Id`
- `Subscription__c.Id`
- `Subscription_Line__c.Id`
adrs.ADR-003:
# ADR-003: Row-local formulas become stored generated columns

Status: Accepted · Owner: Modelling agent · Blueprint `fc71a1458dce`

## Context

Formulas that read only their own row are pure functions of the row.

## Decision

Compile them to GENERATED ALWAYS AS … STORED, with blank-as-zero made explicit.

## Consequences

Always correct, indexable, no application code; formulas using TODAY() cannot use this (see ADR-005).

## Applies to (2)

- `Subscription_Line__c.Line_Total__c`
- `Subscription__c.Annual_Value__c`
adrs.ADR-004:
# ADR-004: Cross-object formulas become views

Status: Accepted · Owner: Modelling agent · Blueprint `fc71a1458dce`

## Context

Generated columns cannot read another table.

## Decision

Expose them through a view that joins the parent records.

## Consequences

Always current; reads go through the view.

## Applies to (1)

- `Subscription_Line__c.Account_Name__c`
adrs.ADR-005:
# ADR-005: Date-dependent formulas are computed when read

Status: Accepted · Owner: Modelling agent · Blueprint `fc71a1458dce`

## Context

A stored value using TODAY() would be wrong tomorrow.

## Decision

Compute in the view using app.today(), evaluated in the org’s time zone.

## Consequences

Matches Salesforce, which also evaluates on read.

## Applies to (1)

- `Subscription__c.Days_To_Renewal__c`
adrs.ADR-006:
# ADR-006: Roll-up summaries are trigger-maintained columns with a recompute job

Status: Accepted · Owner: Modelling agent · Blueprint `fc71a1458dce`

## Context

Roll-ups must be filterable and fast, and correct after bulk loads.

## Decision

Statement-level triggers keep totals current; a recompute function rebuilds them after loads and as a safety net.

## Consequences

Fast reads; load mode defers triggers and recomputes once.

## Applies to (2)

- `Subscription__c.Line_Count__c`
- `Subscription__c.Total_Line_Value__c`
adrs.ADR-007:
# ADR-007: Row-local validation rules become CHECK constraints

Status: Accepted · Owner: Modelling agent · Blueprint `fc71a1458dce`

## Context

Rules that read only the row being saved can be enforced by the database itself.

## Decision

Compile to CHECK constraints named after the rule, keeping the Salesforce error message in the mapping.

## Consequences

Enforced for every writer, including integrations and loads.

## Applies to (6)

- `Opportunity.Closed_Won_Requires_Amount`
- `Opportunity.Loss_Reason_Required_When_Lost`
- `Subscription_Line__c.Quantity_Must_Be_Positive`
- `Subscription__c.Active_Requires_MRR`
- `Subscription__c.Cancellation_Reason_Required`
- `Subscription__c.End_Date_After_Start_Date`
adrs.ADR-008:
# ADR-008: Rules needing the previous row or a parent record become BEFORE-trigger guards

Status: Accepted · Owner: Modelling agent · Blueprint `fc71a1458dce`

## Context

PRIORVALUE, ISCHANGED and cross-object rules cannot be CHECK constraints.

## Decision

Generate BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE triggers that raise the Salesforce message.

## Consequences

Same behaviour as Salesforce; order of guards follows Salesforce’s order of execution.

## Applies to (2)

- `Subscription_Line__c.Parent_Not_Cancelled`
- `Subscription__c.No_Reactivation_After_Cancel`
adrs.ADR-009:
# ADR-009: Profiles and permission sets become roles; sharing becomes row-level security

Status: Accepted · Owner: Modelling agent · Blueprint `fc71a1458dce`

## Context

Access must be enforced where the data lives, not only in the app.

## Decision

One database role per profile or permission set, column grants for field-level security, RLS policies for sharing; the app sets the role per request.

## Consequences

Any client of the database gets the same access rules; policies are tested by parity cases.

## Applies to (3)

- `profile:Admin`
- `profile:Analytics Cloud Integration User`
- `permissionSet:Subscription_Management`
adrs.ADR-010:
# ADR-010: Apex is translated by an AI agent and merged only after review

Status: Accepted · Owner: Modelling agent · Blueprint `fc71a1458dce`

## Context

Apex can do anything; deterministic templates cannot cover it.

## Decision

The Logic agent drafts a translation with tests; it is marked reviewed:false until a person approves it at the gate.

## Consequences

Speed of generation with human accountability; nothing generated merges unchecked.

## Applies to (2)

- `apex-trigger:OpportunityTrigger`
- `apex-trigger:SubscriptionTrigger`
adrs.ADR-011:
# ADR-011: Behaviour is accepted only when it matches Salesforce’s own values

Status: Accepted · Owner: Modelling agent · Blueprint `fc71a1458dce`

## Context

Reviewing generated code line by line does not scale.

## Decision

The Verification agent recomputes every calculated value against what Salesforce stored and replays rule cases; CI blocks release on any mismatch.

## Consequences

Correctness is measured, not asserted; new behaviours need new cases.

## Applies to (1)

- `adlc/5-validate/verification/cases.json`
